entries.zh: 易得；容易得到、容易到手
entries.en: easy to get, easily come by (fácil de verse, lit. 'easy to be seen/obtained')
entries.notes: R 栏残缺；西语 'facil de verse' 与汉字'易得'对应稍歧，据 H/M 栏定为'易得'

entries.zh: 易处置；容易补救、易于修整收拾（易處）
entries.en: easy to remedy or mend; easily dealt with, readily put right
entries.notes: 注音栏含 T99 污损音注；'易處'与西语 'facil de remediar o componer' 的对应含推断

entries.zh: 谐（諧，相合、谐调）——注音句残损不可辨读，与西语'可行'不合，释义存疑
entries.en: feasible, doable (per Spanish); Han gloss 諧 'harmonious, in accord' — phonetic gloss phrase illegible, uncertain
entries.notes: 汉字'諧'与西语 factible 不协，注音尾词 'negifticasi' 残损难辨

entries.zh: 器（器物；才具、可成之器）——三栏互不合，释义存疑
entries.en: implement, vessel; capacity, ability — columns disagree with Sp. 'factible', uncertain
entries.notes: 'factible/器/güy'三栏互不印证，疑栏位错置或字形误读

entries.en: hem, lap or lower border of one's garment; skirt (saya)

entries.zh: 衣裾；裙裾、下摆（所附注音例句污损，例义存疑）
entries.en: hem or lower border of a garment; skirt edge (illustrative phrase smudged)
entries.notes: 注音句含 T99 污损段，短语义不可全辨

entries.en: lower garment, skirt; the skirt of a robe

entries.zh: 裙裤；下裳（汉栏'裾語'当为'裙褲'之误读）
entries.en: skirt-trousers; lower garment (Han 裾語 read as 裙褲 by phonetic inference)
entries.notes: '裾語'据对音 kûn-kù 推断为'裙褲'，凭展开释义

entries.zh: 纱帽（官帽）；官帽之檐——汉栏'祕帽是'疑为'纱帽是'
entries.en: gauze official hat of a mandarin; brim of a hat (Han column reads 祕帽是, likely 紗帽是)
entries.notes: 对音 sé-bō-sī 吻合'纱帽是'而汉字形不合，凭推断展开；与西语'官帽之檐'义稍有出入

entries.en: foot of a mountain; the skirt/foot of the hill
entries.notes: 注音含 T99 污损音注，按例降为低置信

entries.en: mid-slope of a mountain; the skirt of the summit (la falda de la cumbre)
entries.notes: 注音含 T99 污损音注，按例降为低置信
注音含 T99 污损音注，按例降为低置信

entries.zh: 弊（獘）；伪弊、欺诈不实——注音栏残损难辨，释义存疑
entries.en: abuse, fraud; false feigned thing (獘/弊; phonetic column garbled, uncertain)
entries.notes: 注音句 'omliba/cubax/maleşa' 残损不可辨读，且'獘/弊'为存疑字

entries.zh: 无头公案；无头无尾、毫无根据（不实）之事
entries.en: a case without head or foot; groundless, baseless matter
falsehood; a false, deceitful thing (Han 和 likely 譌 'error, false')
entries.notes: 汉栏'和'疑为'譌'，据西语 falsedad 推断；'traçida'拼法未定

entries.zh: 讹秽；邪术妖法之伪秽（巫蛊邪祟）
entries.en: falsehood of sorcery; impure, unclean witchcraft (穢; first char likely 譌)
entries.notes: 首字同前条疑为'譌'；'穢'与邪术义相合

entries.en: to lose; loss, want, fault (falta, perder)
